description: PHASE J0 first control-hydraulic-mechanical joint commissioning of the 15-institute electro-hydraulic steering system.

evidence_tags.VERIFIED_CODE: readable directly from the current official source
evidence_tags.CUSTOMER_GEOMETRY: from the frozen CUSTOMER coordinate file after mm->m conversion
evidence_tags.ASSUMED: engineering assumption required to close an interface but lacking CUSTOMER or cross-module evidence
evidence_tags.UNVERIFIED: not safe to use without further evidence

models.mechanical: mechanics_ackermann_v2 M1 (PhaseM1Model, 4 dof q_front/q4/q5/q6, 12 wheels, 7 physical cylinder interfaces)

hydraulic.integration: explicit RK4 with stage-consistent mechanical load
hydraulic.redundant_valve_note: ASSUMED explicit zero. In the L1-Fast regulated_constant_pressure boundary both SC_1 rails of the redundant wrappers sit on the same regulated rail, so their four-port flows are identically zero at any command; the command is still written explicitly rather than left to an implicit default.

load_model.neutralize_initial_bias_note: The L1-Fast healthy working point sets external_load = A_a*p - A_b*p so that the pre-charged state has a zero mechanical residual. J0 holds that same constant offset for the whole run so that t=0 is a genuine equilibrium and the J0 response is not confused with the pre-charge transient. It is an initialization device, not a measured road load.
load_model.road_load_ramp_note: The road load is faded in over this interval from the pure L1-Fast working-point load so that no step in net force is injected.

control.reference_signal: representative hydraulic stroke of the equivalent actuation group (x_ref), not a wheel angle and not the target angle copied four times

channels.notes: x_front = 0.25*q_front is ASSUMED_ENGINEERING_PARAMETER_INTERFACE_PLACEHOLDER (no CUSTOMER front hardpoints). Measured authority: dirvalve_6 gives zero SC_1 flow only at command +1.0; every command below +1.0 drives x negative, so the reachable set is x<=0.
channel_rear_1 -> q4 is an ASSUMED cross-module mapping. x is the A-cylinder relative length L_A(q4)-L_A(0), an ASSUMED representative coordinate.
channel_rear_2 -> q5 is an ASSUMED cross-module mapping. x is L_A(q5)-L_A(0).
channel_rear_3 -> q6 is an ASSUMED cross-module mapping. x is L_A(q6)-L_A(0).

mapping.rear_representative_source: ASSUMED; CUSTOMER hardpoints and A/B lengths are CUSTOMER_GEOMETRY, the choice of A as the single equivalent channel coordinate is not

load.curvature_source: target ideal Ackermann ICR of the commanded manoeuvre; the vehicle is treated as following the commanded path so that the wheel-angle error appears as tire slip
load.moment_model: M1 solve_loaded_case road-moment formulas re-evaluated on the ACTUAL q; the M1 static compliance correction loaded_q = q - Q/K is deliberately NOT applied
